selected_script.angle: sticky grease mist on kitchen cabinet doors smeared into a gummy paste by a regular wet wipe
selected_script.hook: Extreme close-up of a sticky yellow grease film on a wooden kitchen cabinet door as a standard wet wipe attempts to clean it, but only spreads the grease into a frustrating, tacky paste.

script_record.video_001_part_01: Timeline: 0-3s: Extreme close-up of a kitchen cabinet door near the stove. A finger touches sticky yellow grease, then a wet wipe rubs it, turning it into a cloudy, gummy mess. 3-6s: A hand brings in the NUAN Heavy Duty Degreaser (white bottle, green label) and sprays thick white foam directly onto the sticky paste, dissolving it instantly. 6-10s: A blue microfiber towel wipes the foam away in one effortless swipe, revealing a squeaky-clean cabinet surface.
script_record.video_001_part_02: Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut to a greasy glass microwave tray. Hand sprays the NUAN degreaser foam and immediately wipes it to a sparkling shine. 4-8s: Fast-cut to a greasy stainless steel stovetop dial. The NUAN foam is sprayed on the crevices and wiped completely clean with no streaks. 8-10s: Light text CTA 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.' appears alongside a static shot of the NUAN white bottle next to a pristine stovetop.
